segments.en: Enemy fleet sighted!!
Numerous battleships and cruisers!! They're closing in fast!!
What?! It's not just a recon force?
Not judging by the size of the fleet, sir.
Grr... I thought their goal was to retake the capital...
No significant change in the enemy fleet's movements.
Looks like the jamming worked.
Good. Then our surprise attack succeeded.
We'll be within engagement range of the enemy fleet shortly!
Intercepting enemy fleet transmissions!
This is... a scramble alert.
Looks like they've finally noticed us.
We will now attack the enemy fleet!
Fleet, take assault formation!
Shifting to assault formation! It'll be complete in one minute!
All ships, full barrage!!
Fire!!
Nwaaagh!
Request support from the other units!
Hits confirmed!
The enemy fleet is in disarray!
The enemy fleet's deployment is lagging!
Right wing, left wing, advance!
Launch the attack squadrons at the same time!
One minute to attack squadron launch.
Catapult deck maintenance crews, please clear the deck.
My unit will attack the enemy flagship.
We'll leave ground suppression to the other units.
Roger!
Roger!
Nelfea Squad! Launching!
All units, follow me!!

rows.notes: Blank-header pages assigned to the previous speaker (6 NCO, 10/13/16/23 Lun or Rie by context, 18 Redros officer, 27/31 Nelfea).

segments.en:
<Win Condition>
Sink the enemy ship within the time limit
Engine output dropping! We can't restore it!
Won't the reinforcements make it in time...?
I'm afraid not, sir...
I miscalculated...
I never imagined they still had this much strength left...
Enemy flagship sunk!
Once we've resupplied, we'll mop up the remaining enemies!
Roger!
Roger!
The remaining enemy forces are withdrawing.
Incoming transmission from HQ.
Looks like the operation was a success.
We've wiped out the enemy fleet that was deployed at Zakaal.
We've also nearly finished securing the key areas.
And our losses?
Light, sir.
Nothing that will hinder our operations.
Good!
The reinforcements I sent will reach you shortly.
Once they arrive, I want the Astante II to return to HQ.
Understood.
We'll stand by on alert until then.
Very well!
Then I'll see you at HQ.
We'll now dock at Zakaal.

rows.notes: [accuracy 15] project decision: [jp] = 'dock'

segments.en: Okay, that should do it!
Captain Rie, I've finished putting together the revision list.
Thanks.
I'll send the change requests to the supply unit right away.
By the way, Rie?
Our ship's going back to HQ after this, right?
Yes. A new mission is waiting for us at Astante Fortress.
We'll head back as soon as we're ready.
I see...
Then I'll arrange the civilian goods we're likely to run short of over there.
Thanks, that's a big help.
I'll leave it to you, then.
Maybe I'll get those arrangements started right away.
But I'll have to go out to get civilian goods, won't I?
Changed and ready!
Off I go!
Oh... I forgot...
I need Nelfea to change the squad setup for me...
Huh...?
Isn't she here...?
Did Nelfea "Go Out" too, I wonder...
Come to think of it...
I don't see any of the other pilots either...
Where did everybody go...?

rows.notes: Seg 13: [jp] rendered "civilian goods". Seg 17: [jp] as a verb phrase ("change the squad setup"), not the menu label. | [editorial 21] quoted [jp] is the town command; capitalised like "Depart" and the "Go Out" used in 3960_09379_00

segments.en: Keep it coming! Keep it coming!
That's it, straight ahead!
They've already started loading the containers...
Watch out! Please stand back!
Oh... sure!
Sorry about that!
I was wondering where the pilots had gone...
They're all helping with the loading.
Huh?
Is that Nelfea over there?
What are you doing!
This container doesn't go here!
Huh? It doesn't?
Sigh...
It's written right here, isn't it? That one goes to Deck 3!
Ah...! I'm sorry!
But... um...
Get going!
R-Roger...!
Captain Nelfea... shouldn't we leave loading the materials to the supply unit...?
Some battles won't have steady supplies...
When that happens, we're the ones who have to procure the goods ourselves.
I explained that at the briefing.
But right now, the supply unit is keeping up with us...
Tell me that once you can actually do things properly.
Right now, you people can't even handle loading cargo right.
Just do it!
Y-Yes, ma'am!
Um~ have you got a second?
What? If it's business, make it quick.
Um... about switching the squad setup to Plan B...
I've already taken care of that.
Don't lump me in with the previous captain.
Oh, right, of course.
You're... not like Kanji...
Oh... honestly! I'm not upset about it.
You just do your own job.
Okay.

rows.notes: Seg 34 [jp] = Kanji (Lun answers with his name). Seg 38 [jp] read as Nelfea saying she does not mind (Lun looked hurt), rendered "I'm not upset about it". | [editorial 25] stiff literal "I'd like you to say"; Nelfea is snapping at a subordinate

segments.en: (This is supposed to be where they handle food supplies...)
(It sure doesn't look like it...)
Hellooo! Excuse me!
Yes, welcome!
Oh? Now there's an unusual customer.
What'll it be?
Oh... then, may I have some tea?
Coming right up.
Um, ma'am?
What is it?
I'd like to buy some food.
Food? Not a meal?
Yes. I'd like you to arrange a lot of the groceries on this list.
Hm?
What on earth is this?
Well, sure, I serve food here too...
But I certainly don't deal in this kind of stuff.
But when I looked it up on the net, it said this place was the point of contact.
I never put any ad up on the net, though...
Say... are you one of the kids from that fleet?
Huh?
Well, are you?
Ah... yes...
Thought so...
Sorry, but... I don't want to sell anything to the military.
The army's carted off everything worth having, so nothing's left over for us civilians.
I see...
Not that I'd dare say that to those coup faction people...
I'm sorry... for bringing the fighting here...
Um... please hang in there.
Well, I'll be going now.
Your tea was delicious, ma'am.
Now, hold on a minute.
What is it?
I'll make an exception this time.
I know you folks are struggling too.
But...
I'll get together as much of what's on the list as I can.
I just send it to the port, right?
Thank you so much!
Hurry up and make Claudia a peaceful continent again.
And when you do, come back here and see me.
I will!

rows.notes: Civilian here is a shopkeeper Lun calls [jp] ("ma'am"). [jp] = "the coup faction". | [editorial 39] "This time's special" read oddly (accuracy flag); same meaning

segments.en: (The warehouses around here should have daily necessities...)
Hey, missy. What're you doing here?
Oh, um...
Go on home, quick!
This is no place for someone like you.
I came here for a reason.
Do you know... the person at Warehouse 16?
Warehouse 16?
Yes, that's right.
Do you know about it?
Don't tell me you're military.
Yes, I am.
So you came here to buy, huh...
Um... could you be the contact for the deal?
Those papers... did you write 'em?
Yes, I did.
I see...
Did I... get something wrong?
Nope... they showed what kind of person you are, all right.
Huh? Did they?
I've got the goods ready.
Follow me!
I gathered everything here in this warehouse.
Check it over.
Thank you very much.
Hauling it from here is up to you folks, though.
A fleet like that's gotta have a big launch or two, right?
Yes. I'll call one over right away.
Um... mister?
Thank you for everything.
I think everyone on the ship will be really happy.
I'm too old to put up a decent fight anymore...
I was glad I could help.
I'm counting on you folks.
Yes...
See ya...
Hang in there, missy.
I've made the call...
The supply unit can take it from here.

rows.notes: Civilian here is an older man Lun calls [jp] ("mister"); he calls her [jp] ("missy"). | [accuracy 34] subject restored: the old man speaks for himself ([jp] in k32); 'We' was an unsupported generalization

segments.en: The cargo's all arranged, so I'd better report to Captain Rie.
What's that...?
There, all changed!
Who's there...?
Where am I?

Where did you go...?
Yu...
A girl's voice?
Who could it be...
Oh, Lun.
Arranging the cargo must've been tough, huh?
Not really. The people were kind, so it went fine.
By the way, have our reinforcements arrived?
They contacted us just a moment ago.
Once the cargo's loaded, let's head out.
Okay.
Right, time to get one more job done!
Um... Rie...
Hm? What is it?
Oh...
Sorry... it's nothing.
Really?
See you later, then!
That girl's voice I heard earlier...
Was it really okay not to report it...?
"Depart" is now available.

rows.notes: Seg 7: [jp] = You (glossary-binding name, You Isami); "You..." here is the name, which reads oddly in English. Seg 27: menu term [jp] kept as "Depart". | [accuracy 7] late decision: [jp] = 'Yu' (was 'You') | [proofread 27] late decision: the Depart-available system line is '"Depart" is now available.'

segments.en: This ship will now proceed at full speed to "Astante Fortress."
Course clear.
Displaying a marker on "Astante Fortress."
All sections report no abnormalities.
Astante II, launch!
We're off course. Correcting our heading.
Unidentified flying object approaching! Count... one!
Just one?
It isn't giving off a friendly signal.
Type and model unknown!
Launch interceptors!!
Roger!!
That girl... she's the one whose voice I heard!
Huh?
It's all right, she's not an enemy.
Open the hangar hatch!
What?
You want me to come in?
I've never seen a machine like that...
Is that girl... going to be all right...?
She's coming out.
Um... nice to meet you.
I'm... Hime Utsumiya.
I'm Lun Forest.
It's nice to meet you, Hime.
Oh, yeah... nice to meet you too.
Looks like we'd better leave this to Lun.
Seems that way.
Lun, would you please take Hime to the sickbay?
Roger!
Come on, Hime, let's go.
Hey, wait! What's going on?
Aww! I keep telling you, I'm fine now!
Don't push yourself.
But I've gotta push myself! I made a promise!
That's why I have to hurry back to Byston Well...
Oh, so you used to live in Byston Well, Hime.
Oh... not exactly...
I was staying there until a little while ago.
But then I got thrown here... and this doesn't seem to be Earth, either...
Aaagh, what am I gonna do!
Calm down.
Nothing you tell me will surprise me, so don't worry, okay?
O-Okay...
Sigh... you're right... panicking won't help.
Hmm... where should I start...
Listen, Hime.
This is top secret, since it's right before an operation, but...
This ship... is going to leave this continent soon.
When it does, I'm sure you'll get to see Yu again.
Huh? Wh-Why?
You know Yu? Don't tell me he came here?!
No, it's not that. I heard your voice, that's all...
Huh? How?
I'm sure Yu is in that place called Byston Well.
You think so...?
Yes, I'm sure... I'm sure you'll meet again.
I'm setting out on a journey too. To look for someone precious to me.
Someone... precious...?
I don't think meeting you was a coincidence.
So let's go together.
Miss... Lun...
Ah...
Ugh... I'm dizzy...
It's all right. You just let your guard down all at once.
Get plenty of rest and get your strength back.
Thank you, Miss Lun.
Just "Lun" is fine.
See you later, then.
Lun, huh...
What a strange girl...
But... somehow, she feels so warm...
Maybe Lun's Organic power... is what drew the Brain here...
I'd better get back to the bridge.
Sorry to keep you waiting!
So? How is she doing?
She's sound asleep.
So, did you find anything out?
Yes...
Hime... seems to have been thrown through all sorts of worlds before ending up here.
She said she was in Byston Well until a little while ago.
So she did come from an outside world...
We have been observing distortions in space-time lately.
Still, Lun... how did you know?
I wonder...
It's like something I'd almost forgotten... has come back to me.
Your "ability" is growing stronger, is that it?
Yes... So that operation of ours... I'm sure it'll go well.
I don't know why, but I feel confident about it.
Let's do our best! It's going to go well, right?
Yeah!
Returning to our planned route.
Setting our course back to Astante Fortress.

rows.notes: [jp] = You (binding glossary name for You Isami); segs 45/50 read "see You" / "You is" -- capitalized name, awkward but binding. Hime's [jp] -> "Miss Lun" so that Lun's [jp] ("Just Lun is fine") keeps its point. Seg 68 [jp] -> "Organic power" (Brain Powerd term; not in glossary); [jp] -> "Brain". Seg 15 [jp] read as the pilot climbing out of the machine.

segments.en: We've arrived at Astante Fortress.
There's a transmission from HQ.
Rie, report to HQ as soon as you've docked.
Has something changed in the situation?
Enemy forces are massing.
We may see a battle before long.
I'm reworking the operation plan.
Understood.
I'll be waiting, then.

rows.notes: [accuracy 2] project decision: [jp] = 'dock'

segments.en: Good work, everyone.
There's still time before our next orders are decided,
so all of you get some rest while you can.
Well then, I'm off to HQ!
Oh, Rie!
Aww... she's already gone...
She's always so busy, isn't she?
Yeah...
Well, let's go rest up like we were ordered.
See you, I'm heading off first!
Hmm... where should I go...

rows.notes: [editorial 8] "take our rest" unidiomatic

segments.en: Team 3! You lot! You're slacking off!
Ma'am!
You'll be going into real combat soon,
and with the attitude you've got now, you won't survive!
Yes, ma'am!!
Resuming special training!
Everyone, board your machines!!
Come to think of it, Nelfea...
was in charge of training the new pilots...
And Rie went flying off to HQ...
We only just got here... and everyone's already so busy...

rows.notes: Seg 2-3 split sentence kept across pages as in the source.

segments.en:
The command center is holding a strategy meeting.
You cannot enter.
Come to think of it, Rie...
is probably in the strategy meeting right about now...
Our forces have secured the production bases at Zakaal and in the Astante Mountains.
From here on, I want every unit to concentrate on building up its strength.
Any questions?
Commander... may I?
There's something I'd like to bring to your attention, sir...
What is it?
Retaking Zakaal has raised the troops' morale, which is a good thing, but...
The view that we should seize the capital in one stroke and take back the continent is spreading among them.
I imagine it is...
Many of our soldiers left family behind...
True, there aren't that many Redros troops stationed on the Claudia Continent.
But the Redros Army is connected to the world outside the continent.
There's no telling how much strength they're holding in reserve...
And on top of that, our opponent is none other than Binzvanker.
It's only reasonable to assume the enemy has already secured production bases bigger than Zakaal...
But... how much of this information should we share with the troops...
If they keep facing an enemy they can't make out, their anxiety will only grow.
Indeed...
But either way, holding the entire continent with our current strength will be difficult.
Even if we did manage to retake the capital, our forces would end up spread thin defending each city.
Attacking by force could also provoke fighting in the streets.
We'll just have to explain why they must hold back for now.
I suppose so...
This war is going to be a long one.
Retaking the capital will require thorough preparation.
For now, the key is to shorten our front and concentrate on defense.
You mean a defense line linking Astante Fortress and the Zakaal Industrial Complex?
Exactly.
Within that range, even our current fleet strength can hold it well enough.
And then we wait for a chance to strike back, I take it.
But we still can't shake our unease about an enemy we can't make out...
We don't even know how big the world beyond the Sea of Clouds is...
True.
To turn to the counteroffensive, we'll need to grasp the enemy's situation.
If we only defend, the gap between us and the enemy will just keep widening.
Do you have something in mind, Commander?
Hmm...
To grasp the enemy's situation, we need to extend our antennae outward.
First, we'll form a new fleet and send it beyond the Claudia Continent.
Beyond the Claudia Continent...?
You mean opening a gate and going to other worlds, the way the Redros fleet did?
That's right.
I've already worked out the fleet's composition for it.
What would the fleet do in those other worlds?
One task is gathering information, but...
more important is forming alliances with the powers of those other worlds.
Is such a thing even possible?
The enemy is already doing exactly that.
Warn them of the danger the Redros Army poses, and gather the powers who'll side with us...
I think it's probably possible.
But it goes against our principle of avoiding interference with other worlds.
I know. But right now, we have no other option.
Rie, I'm putting you in command of the expeditionary fleet.
Only you and your people can understand the folly of what we've done, and overcome it.
You'll do this for me, won't you?
Understood.
I'll take charge of the fleet.

rows.notes: Seg 57 [jp] read as Rie and her comrades ("you and your people"). Seg 58 [jp] rendered "I'm counting on you. Will you do it?". | [editorial 42] consistency: "the gate" lower-case in 02 row 24 k43 (accuracy flag) | [editorial 58] "I'm counting on you. Will you do it?" was an expansion; [jp] as one pressing question (accuracy flag)

segments.en: This place is so calming, just like I thought...
I'll rest here a little while...
Well... I guess I should head back soon.
Oh, Miss Luuun!
Hm? What is it?
Um... if it's all right...
Could we take a commemorative photo with you?
Sure.
I've got time for that much.
Woo-hoo!
Hey! Everybody, gather round!
Yeaaah!!
Hehe, you all look like you're having fun.
Thank you very much!
That was a lot of fun.
Hm? But isn't there training this afternoon? Did it get canceled?
Huh...? What's wrong, everyone?
We're...
We... just can't go along with some of Captain Nelfea's methods.
So we talked it over and decided to sit out today's training.
You're not going to train...?
Is that true?
Yeah...
We do feel bad about doing this to Captain Nelfea.
But...
Every chance she gets, it's "real combat this, real combat that"...
I know she's trying hard, but that personality of hers is tough to take.
Ha ha! You said it!
Wait a minute!
She may sound harsh sometimes, but...
that's... because she's thinking of you all, isn't it?
Deep down she's kind, and she's a really good girl.
We know that.
She's younger than me, but she's got her act together, and she's skilled, too...
Right?
But sometimes that just ends up putting more pressure on us.
She's such a serious person, after all...
Hey! Quit playing the goody-goody and beating around the bush!
You just overrated her, that's all!
Just 'cause she's got talent, she looks down on everyone around her!
In short, she's just a brat!
You think so too, right, Miss Lun?
Huh...?
Yeah, really.
Not just with you, Miss Lun -- she's that arrogant even with Captain Rie.
We volunteered to come here to save Claudia!
Maybe we don't have the skills yet...
but we're not afraid to fight!
That's right!
We're just now getting ready to stand up and fight!
Having that crushed by some brat who's nothing but a lump of ego -- I won't stand for it!
M-Miss Lun...?
You don't understand anything!
Huh...?
The battlefield... the battlefield is...
a far more horrible place than any of you imagine.
But that's exactly why trust between comrades is so important.
Because fighting on the same battlefield means sharing your lives with one another.
The way someone talks, their personality... real comrades should be able to get past things like that easily.
And yet... it's so cruel of you... all of you...
Miss Lun... we didn't mean it like that.
It's just, there's a limit, you know...
Has Nelfea ever abandoned any of you?
Has she ever left someone who was struggling to fend for themselves?
She never did, did she?
Nelfea thinks seriously about each and every one of you.
Nelfea is giving it everything she has, too...
So I want all of you to help her out.
Um, I'm going back to training.
What? You're bailing on us already?
Well...
Fine, whatever. Do what you want!
I'm sorry for lecturing you like that.
When I'm... not even a pilot.
Please don't worry about that.
Don't worry. We'll...
You lot! Quit playing the goody-goodies!
Why don't you think about it too?
About what you yourself need most right now.
Yeah... I'll think it over.
I mean, even I...
Yes... I know...
Well... I really have to get going now.
Um... Miss Lun.
Yes?
...Thank you... so much...
Okay, see you.

rows.notes: Volunteers' genders unknown and mixed (one uses [jp], others [jp]); no pronouns used for them. [jp] from the volunteers -> "Miss Lun" (cf. "Ms. Diane"). Seg 56 [jp]: Lun apparently slaps the loudest volunteer (not stated). Seg 91 [jp] left trailing. | [accuracy 47] dokoroka mistranslated as 'Forget you', which reads as a jab at Lun; it means 'not only with you' | [editorial 26] "feel bad about it toward" unidiomatic | [editorial 65] flow: "that's so cruel... all of you" did not connect

segments.en: Oh, Lun! Wait a second!
Hm? What's up?
Uh, well...
Sorry... for making you look after my subordinates.
Huh?
Oh... I'm sorry.
Those kids... were saying such awful things about you, so I just...
Did I overstep...?
Oh, no, that's not what I mean.
You scolded my students for me...
So... I just wanted to say thank you, that's all.
Huh?
I'm not bothered by the badmouthing. Or the group boycott, either.
Huh? You're not?
This is just one stage in a unit's growth.
A stage?
A unit falls into step through a bit of push and pull.
It's because each person has their own character that a unit functions.
Raising everyone's skill and knowledge matters, but they don't need to be perfectly identical.
Weapons can be replaced, but no one can make the same person twice...
That's why I believe we have to value every single one of them...
Nelfea... you're amazing...
And yet, I'm sorry... I can't help you with anything...
You were helping me just now, weren't you?
That was within my expectations, too.
Huh...? What do you mean?
It's because you're here that I can be strict with those kids.
Really?
You've got your scatterbrained side, of course, and so do Rie and Kanji...
But... you've all got even more strengths... lots of things I don't have.
You know, today, Nelfea, you're kind of...
Sigh... even I get nervous before a big battle...
I see...
See you!

rows.notes: Seg 16 [jp] rendered loosely ("a bit of push and pull"). Seg 30 trails off as in the source. | [editorial 19] "make another of the same person" awkward | [editorial 28] person mix (Rie and Kanji absent, accuracy/proofread flag); same meaning | [editorial 29] follows k28 rewrite: strengths belong to all three

segments.en: Lun, could you wait a moment?
Oh, yes. What is it?
It's about Nelfea... she isn't causing you any trouble, is she?
Not at all!
I could tell Nelfea thinks very seriously about everyone.
I see...
As I thought, she seems to be wound too tight.
Nelfea... is?
She did say she was nervous, but...
She's feeling the pressure of filling the gap Kanji left.
Kanji was always the one who eased the unit's tension, after all.
Is that so...
Rie is also swamped with work, so she can't fully show her natural flexibility.
As a result, a tense atmosphere is spreading through the whole unit.
You may not realize it, Lun,
but you walking among everyone like this helps more than you know.
Y-You're exaggerating.
I just like taking walks, that's all.
That's all it takes.
I'll be counting on you from now on, too.

rows.notes: [editorial 19] "I'm counting on you from here on, too" clunky

segments.en: Hmm... my work's all done. What should I do now?
Oh, I know.
Maybe I'll ask Rie to show me another famous local shop.
Is she still on the bridge?
Is there anything I can help with?
Huh? Is nobody here...?
The lights are on, though...
Zzz... zzz... zzz...
Rie? Are you there?
Zzz... zzz...
Zzz... zzz... zzz...
You haven't changed, Rie.
Zzz... zzz... zzz...
Good night.

rows.notes: Seg 7: breathing under the Narration header; rendered as sleep sounds (it is Rie asleep).

segments.en: Oh...
It's this late already...
Maybe I should get some rest too.

Get some rest
Not yet
Yes... I have an early morning tomorrow.
I should get some rest.
It's still light out,
so maybe I'll walk around a bit more.

rows.notes: Seg 3 is a choice page: one option per line.

segments.en: Huh...?
Why am I... here...
If I remember right, this place is...
What a nice breeze...
Heeey! Luuuun!
Luuun! Can't you hear me?
Huh...?
Kanji...?
Kanji... is that you?
Can't you see me? I'm right in front of you.
Oh... you really are.
Kanji... you're right by my side, aren't you?
Lun... are you okay?
My feelings reached you, like this. So I'm fine now.
More importantly... Kanji, what's wrong? You seem a little down...
D-Do I?
Yes...
Hey, what's the matter?
Hm?
I've been giving it my all, but... is it really okay to keep going like this...?
I feel like... I'm drifting further and further away from everyone in Claudia...
Don't worry. Just keep moving forward the way you are, Kanji, and you'll be fine.
You think so...?
You're not wrong, Kanji...
Keep your heart calm, and believe in yourself.
I see...
Got it. I'll keep charging ahead like this. Thanks, Lun.
Kanji......
We'll meet again... We'll meet again for sure, won't we...

rows.notes: Seg 4 under the Narration header is Kanji calling from off-screen. | [accuracy 2] restored tashika ('if I remember right'): Lun half-recognises the place

segments.en: The next day...
Send the fleet outside the continent?
To learn the enemy's scale, and to gather allies and build them into a force that can oppose it.
Those are the two goals the expeditionary fleet is being sent out for.
That's far too haphazard.
Without any clear destination,
sending this much strength out of Claudia...
Charging ahead blindly won't achieve anything.
This is an official operation decided by Supreme HQ.
It can't be called off.
What about our level of training?
So many units were thrown together in a hurry, we'll have no choice but to bring low-skilled pilots along.
That's true...
But... if we just sit on our hands...
then as long as we stay in Claudia, we'll be dancing in the palm of the Redros Army's hand.
It's all right... we'll get results.
What...?!
I can feel Kanji's energy.
And a great power in tune with it...
A power in tune...?
People who share the same heart as us...
Their circle keeps growing bigger and bigger.
You mean...
Believe me.
Lun, are you serious?
This isn't just a lie to get us through the moment, is it?
It's true. Believe me, Nelfea.
Sigh... I know you couldn't lie to save your life.
All right. Let's steel ourselves and go for it.
Okay, time to get ready to depart!
Captain Nelfea! How did it go?
The operation stands. Get to your positions!
Is it really going to be okay?
Who knows...
But if we're doing it, we'll give it everything we've got!
Lun, I can handle things here now.
Could you go out there and check the items on the list in person?
You mean the storehouse at Zaxel Pass, right?
Roger, I'm on my way!

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary -> "Zaxel Pass" (romanized). Seg 18 [jp] -> "Kanji's energy". [jp] -> "Supreme HQ". | [editorial 2] clarity: "build them into a force that can oppose them" had two clashing "them" | [editorial 22] "Their gathering keeps growing" unidiomatic

segments.en: Zaxel Pass...
Turns out you can find plenty if you look.
You're right.
I never thought they'd have this much stored away, did you?
You said it.
The rest is heavy lifting. The men in my unit will take care of it, so you can head back now.
Sorry to leave it all to you...

Aww! Captain!
Seriously?!
What about gender equality?!

Idiot!
An operator can't handle heavy machinery!
I'm sorry.
Miss Lun, this is an old passage and it's dangerous. Let me escort you back to the station.
Hey!!
Ow, ow, ow...!
You, get to work already!

U-Um...
I'll go back on my own.
Right. Be careful.
Like this guy said, it's easy to get lost around here.
Okay!
Well, I'll be going, then!

Waaah!
I got lost!
Ugh... I've walked all this way and I still can't see the station...
I can sense someone over this way...
You're...!
Hm?
You...!

Could it be...
Lun Forest?!

Omega...
What are you doing here?
You can't answer?
Do you understand? I'm your enemy.
You spotted me first... so why aren't you pointing a gun at me...?

Right now...
I don't want to fight.
I don't understand you...
I'm the man who shot Kanji down.

Kanji...
Kanji is alive...
And what about you? Why didn't you shoot me?
Because you have no killing intent.
Is that all?
Let's see...
Maybe it's because you could be of use to me.
You people can open the gate without my power, can't you?
Heh... That's enough prying. You're going to be my hostage.
This gun has a silencer. No one around here will hear a thing.
Listen. Stay right by my side. Step away, and I'll shoot without mercy!
How obedient.
Good. Come with me!
Where are we going?
Aren't we going outside?
Further in, there's something I'm supposed to collect.
Where is this...?
The sub-control room of the factory plant.
From here, you can assemble the countless parts managed by Astante Fortress.
Now, just watch.
What is this...?
The Shell Blade...
A machine I once had a hand in building.
Something like this...
You came all this way just to get something like this?
More or less...
How long are you people going to... rely on power like this?
Why won't you talk with us before you start fighting?
Our two positions will never meet...
Talking any further would only produce some worthless compromise.
But...!
We're going over to the machine.
Follow me!
Lun... Earlier you said you didn't want to fight... didn't you?
Yes...
Then why are you aboard the Astante II?
I... I thought I could help Kanji and everyone...
And so you volunteered for the military, is that it?
Well, that's your own choice. I don't mind it, but...
If you hate fighting, you shouldn't be aboard a battleship.
I suppose not...

But...
to me now,
those people are...
my irreplaceable family...
...The way you think is hardly that of a soldier.

No...
I suppose it isn't...
Heh heh... But thanks to that, I'm starting to see what their plan is.
Huh?
What do you mean?
They took you on because of that special ability of yours.
They're planning to use it...
Am I wrong?
You have strategic value.
Sorry, but you'll be keeping me company a while longer.
The final adjustments are done.
Now all that's left is to climb aboard.
Don't move!
I had a pretty good idea you'd show up here!
Surrender at once!!

Professor Rondo...
Impressive as ever.
To think you saw my move coming...
Ugh...!
Professor!
Pointing a gun at me is reckless, you know.

You're the reckless one,
Omega Fokurosu!

Hm...
A perfect ambush...
...is that it?
But I have Lun's life in my hands.
Now, what will you do?
Ngh...
Everyone, hold your fire!!
Damn it!
Heh...

(No...
 because of me...)
Omega...! I'll give you that machine!
In exchange, let Lun go!
Do that, and we'll let you escape!

Heh...
Very well.
Then I'll help myself to this machine.

Professor!!
Are you all right?

Yeah...
It just grazed my right arm.

I'm sorry...
It's my fault...
No...
You saw what happened just now. Not pointing a gun at him was the right call.
More importantly, I'm glad you weren't hurt, Lun.
Professor...
We need to hurry back. The enemy may be closing in.
Right!

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary: romanized 'Zaxel Pass'. Seg 6 [jp] read as Lun's apologetic thanks for leaving the heavy work to the men. Seg 7 [jp] -> 'Captain' (the officer is the unit's leader; brief rule). Seg 43 [jp] lower-case 'the gate'. Seg 102: Rondo is evidently shot here (confirmed by seg 121). Seg 114 thought kept in parentheses; [jp] rendered 'because of me'. | [accuracy 10] project decision: rusan from those who use the honorific = 'Miss Lun' (not 'Ms.') | [accuracy 124] 'our guns' was an unsupported referent; the source does not say who held back (likely Lun earlier, possibly the squad), so kept neutral | [editorial 2] "It sure does." did not answer "Turns out you can find plenty if you look." (accuracy flag) | [editorial 47] "If you leave it" (my side) awkward

segments.en: An enemy intrusion has been confirmed inside the fortress.
We're moving up the start of the operation. All hands, hurry with your final checks!
"Depart" is now available.

rows.notes: Seg 2 [jp]: plain 'depart' (UI command is "Depart"). | [editorial 2] consistency: same system line as 00 row 8 k27 | [proofread 2] late decision: the Depart-available system line is '"Depart" is now available.'

segments.en: Don't worry. Those kids will see it through, I'm sure of it.
Tail, I'm always causing you trouble.
Leave the backup to me.

I'm sorry...
Please... look after them.
Heh... Who'd have thought I'd end up covering your daughter's back instead of yours.
Tail...

Tail Kinui!
Returning to my unit!

rows.notes: [editorial 1] "putting you to trouble" unidiomatic

segments.en: Enemy fleet approaching!!
So they came after all...
Enemy fleets are coming in from two directions!
That overlaps with our planned course...
At this rate we're gonna get surrounded! Are we going to be okay?
You can use that machine of yours, can't you?
You mean my Brain?

We're sortieing.
You're coming with me!

Huh?
H-Hey, wait!
We can leave Hime to Nelfea.

What do we do,
Captain Rie?
Put me through to Commander Akatsuki.
Roger!
Commander Akatsuki!! The expeditionary fleet will break through the enemy's right wing and head straight for the Sea of Clouds!
Please cover us!
Right, understood!

All ships, sortie!!
Drive back the enemy fleet!!
Open fire!!
Fleet, maximum battle speed!! We're breaking through the enemy fleet!
All ships, follow the Astante II!

rows.notes: Seg 6 [jp] -> 'my Brain' (Hime's Brain Powerd). Seg 10 [jp] 'Captain Rie' (ship captain); seg 11/13 [jp] 'Commander Akatsuki' (Kyo).

segments.en: The enemy fleet is pushing out ahead!!
Stop them!
Take out the enemy ships ahead! We're opening a breach!
Mech Squads, launch!!
Hime! We're heading out!
I know!
We just have to chase those guys off, right?

Ready...?
Here we go!
Enemies coming in from the flank!!
Lieutenant Min, how do you like Claudia's skies?
Not bad. This wind... Just flying in it, I can feel it buzzing through my machine.
So this is what they call the Cloud Stream?
That's right...
Your machine has been given the coating too, but
it can't take as much as an FT can. Stay away from the Sea of Clouds.
I know!
Meio Plato, is it?
We'll hit the enemy from the flank! I'm counting on you!
I believe I understand the situation. Allow me to lend a hand!
Heh... An army with ideals is strong. And we now stand within one...
Let's do this!
Now is the time to show them what we're made of!
Whatever the enemy, there's no call to hold back!
Deal with them calmly and swiftly.
Sir!!
Here we go!!
This is bad... Hitting us right before we launch...!
Who are you?!
FT platoon, fortress garrison! We're here to support the Astante II!
You're at a disadvantage in that position! Pull back!
If you lose the flagship, it's all for nothing...
We'll be your shield. Whatever it takes, we need you to break through here!

Cross the Sea of Clouds...
and reach the Redros Army's home base...!
Please...!

Understood...
We'll make this operation succeed, no matter what!

All right!
Let's get this show on the road!
The Astante II crew's morale has risen.
During this battle, the crew's combat level is temporarily raised.
All ships, engage!

<Win Condition>
Sink the enemy mothership within the time limit.

rows.notes: Seg 3 [jp] -> 'Mech Squads' (UI term). Seg 7: Hime, probably to her Brain. Seg 10 [jp] 'Captain Min'. Seg 17 Omega addressing Meio, who answers in seg 19. Seg 27: Nelfea's line trails off as in JP (the enemy hits before the mech squads have launched).

segments.en: So this is it...

Heh...!
Not bad at all...
We need to resupply too, or we'll be out of ammunition.
Indeed...
We can still fight!
Fall back. Push any further and you'll die for nothing.
But...!
Why, you little greenhorns!
Quit giving your commander a hard time!

Right!
All units, withdraw!
All units, return to the ship. We're pulling out of this airspace at full speed!

rows.notes: Seg 8 [jp] -> 'your commander' (Meio, Min addressing Welner and Karl). | [editorial 7] "wet-behind-the-ears chicks" mixed idiom, and "chicks" reads as gendered slang; [jp] = greenhorns

segments.en:
Rie!!
Leave the rest to me!
Go!!
We're leaving the front line at maximum battle speed!
All ships, move out!!

rows.notes: Seg 0 [jp]: Kyo speaking for his fleet; 'me' chosen (could be 'us').

segments.en: How bad is the fleet's damage?
One cruiser moderately damaged. It has turned back to Astante Fortress.
This ship took hits too... Lun, what's the damage report?
Sensors show no problems. Just in case, I'll check with Professor Rondo.
Damage at this level is nothing to worry about. Emergency repairs will handle it.
More importantly, we should be reaching the Sea of Clouds soon.
We'll observe the space-time distortion at the planned point.
Understood. I'll have the observation equipment readied.
Lun... I'm sorry, but I need to borrow your power.
Of course, gladly!
But...
What's wrong...?
Connecting the worlds... I don't think that in itself is a bad thing.
But if it's what brings war down on us...
It's precisely because we felt that way in the last war
that we held back from crossing the Sea of Clouds and mingling with other worlds...
But many people believe it would be good for barriers like region and race to disappear.
And that's exactly what the Redros Army took advantage of...
But someday, everyone should be able to join hands.
For that to happen, we've gotta teach a lesson to the people who've let power go to their heads.
That's true...
I'm sorry...
There's no point looking back now...
Everyone feels that way.
After all, nobody wants a war.
Yeah, that's right...
Well, it's about time we got started!
After all, so many people have put their hopes in us.
Here goes. We're starting up the device.

Cloud System...
Overdrive!

Hime...
Will you help me?
Can I... really do it?
Yes... It's the same
as with that Brain of yours.
I see...
Okay... I'll give it a try.
I want you to feel it... the breath of life... flowing in from the other world...
Okay...
W-Wow...! There's a huge hole in the Sea of Clouds!
Beyond it... I'm sure a whole new world is waiting.
Yeah... Somehow, I can feel it too.
And now... our journey begins all over again, doesn't it?
Come on, let's go!

rows.notes: Seg 2 [jp] -> 'Lun'. Seg 23 [jp]: read as 'everyone has that thought/doubt' (answering Lun's worry that linking worlds brings war). Seg 32-33 one sentence split across pages, cut at the same point; [jp] ('that Brain kid') -> 'that Brain of yours'. | [accuracy 27] restored the causal -dakara linking this to 'let's get started' | [editorial 23] "Everyone thinks about it." vague; answers Lun's worry (translator note)
